skills.name: Etiquette
skills.description: Honors etiquette and trains the body and soul. Good effects on allies.  *Evade Rate +30% (10 sec) *Skill Evade Rate +30% (10 sec) *ATK +300% (10 sec)

skills.name: Boss Shoulder Throw
skills.description: Throws Boss over the shoulder to attack. Bad effects on enemies.  *ATK per sec x 400% Area Damage (7 sec) *Enemy ATK -40% (7 sec) *Enemy Skill Hit Rate -40% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Caffeine
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability won't fall asleep in advent stages  with the Deep Sleep obstacle effect.

abilities.name: Mineral Swipe
abilities.description: Each time deployed, has a high chance of stealing a certain amount of Minerals from opponents.  - This Ability activates only in PVP and Guild Battles. - If an ally triggers an Ability of the same type, this one won’t activate again for 1 seconds. - You can't exceed your Mineral max, and you can't steal more Minerals than the opponent has left.
